description: This file contains database migration scripts and setup functions for upgrading vTiger CRM from version 5.1.0 to 5.2.0 RC. It includes SQL queries for altering, creating tables, and inserting default data, as well as PHP functions to populate security fields, define web services, create workflows, and handle custom view migrations.

classes.name: VTWorkflowManager
classes.description: Class for managing workflows, creating, and saving them.

classes.name: VTTaskManager
classes.description: Class for creating and managing workflow tasks.

methods.name: migration520_populateFieldForSecurity
methods.description: Adds missing entries into vtiger_def_org_field and vtiger_profile2field for security fields.

methods.name: VT520_webserviceMigrate
methods.description: Sets up custom web services for CRM migration from 5.1.0 to 5.2.0 RC.

methods.name: VT520_migrateCustomview
methods.description: Migrates custom view column configurations to new format.

methods.name: VT520_updateCVColumnList
methods.description: Updates column list entries in vtiger_cvcolumnlist table.

methods.name: VT520_updateADVColumnList
methods.description: Updates advanced filter column entries in vtiger_cvadvfilter table.

methods.name: VT520_queryGeneratorMigration
methods.description: Performs several database updates and data migrations related to custom views and fields.

methods.name: VT520_manageIndexes
methods.description: Adds and drops indexes on key tables for performance optimization.

methods.name: VT520_fieldCleanUp
methods.description: Adjusts field type definitions and cleans up data in specific fields.
